units.source_text: 两人交谈，隔阂未消，天明时公子告辞出门。

en.t: The two talked together, but the distance between them did not disappear; at daybreak the prince took his leave and went out.

units.source_text: 六条妃子看到他那俊美的丰姿，觉得还是不忍抛开他而独自远行。

en.t: When Lady Rokujo saw his handsome, elegant figure, she felt that she still could not bear to cast him aside and go away alone.

units.source_text: 但又思量：“他的正夫人素来受他重视，

en.t: But then she reflected, "His principal wife has always been valued by him,

units.source_text: 今又将生男育女，结果他的爱情定然集注于她一人身上。

en.t: and now she is about to bear and raise his children, so in the end his love will surely be fixed on her alone.

units.source_text: 而我在这里翘盼他的惠临，无非是自讨苦吃而已。”

en.t: As for me, waiting here so eagerly for the favor of his visit is nothing but bringing suffering on myself."

units.source_text: 暂时忘怀了的忧思，现在重新涌上心头来了。

en.t: The sorrowful thoughts she had forgotten for a while now surged back into her heart.

units.source_text: 其时日色已暮，只收到了源氏公子的一封信。

en.t: By then the day had already grown dark, and she received only a single letter from Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 信上写道：“近日病势稍减，今又忽然加重，故我未便抽身……”

en.t: The letter said, "Recently the illness had eased somewhat, but now it has suddenly worsened again, so I cannot conveniently leave..."

units.source_text: 六条妃子推想他又是托辞，便回答他一封信：

en.t: Lady Rokujo supposed that he was making excuses again, and so she wrote him a letter in reply:
